user.title: Connect BasaltNotes
user.description: The vault holds the instructions and the memory of your voice assistant. It is created if it does not exist yet.

data_description.url: The address of your BasaltNotes server, with the port
data_description.token: A token with the permission to create vaults (create_vault) is enough. In BasaltNotes: Settings → API tokens.

reauth_confirm.title: New API token
reauth_confirm.description: BasaltNotes no longer accepts the stored token.

error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or may not access this vault.
error.unknown: Unexpected answer from the server, see the log.

abort.reauth_successful: The new token has been saved.

data.memory_budget: Characters of matching notes per question
data.embedding_api_key: API key of the embedding server

data_description.memory_budget: Corrections and facts are searched for each question, and only the best matches go into the prompt, up to this length. The rest costs nothing.
data_description.embedding_url: OpenAI-compatible address of the server ending in /v1; for Ollama the server with port 11434 and /v1. Then notes are chosen by meaning, not only by shared words. Empty = words only.
data_description.embedding_model: For Ollama for example embeddinggemma (ollama pull embeddinggemma).
data_description.embedding_api_key: Only if the server needs one.
